Overview

Lamia is a city in Central Greece with a population of 75,315. Central Greece’s capital with a strategic location, medieval castle, and gateway to Mount Oeta. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
